content.value_statement: Apple system surfaces have distinct content, layout, privacy, and update constraints. This skill applies focused HIG guidance to choose and design the right experience.
actual_capabilities: Recommends an Apple system surface that fits the product goal and platform.
Defines glanceable content priorities and identifies information to omit.
Plans update timing and lifecycle behavior for widgets and Live Activities.
Adapts layouts across widget sizes, Dynamic Island presentations, and complication families.
Specifies deep-link destinations and direct actions for system surfaces.
Reviews privacy, accessibility, and attention concerns in notifications and visible experiences.
limitations: Provides design guidance, not production Swift, SwiftUI, or WidgetKit code.
Does not replace testing on supported devices, display modes, or accessibility settings.
Reference snapshots may not include changes from the latest Apple platform releases.
Recommendations depend on product context, supported platforms, data timing, and user goals.

use_cases.title: Plan a glanceable iOS experience
use_cases.description: Choose between a widget, Live Activity, notification, or quick action and define its content hierarchy.

use_cases.title: Translate requirements into platform behavior
use_cases.description: Define size variants, refresh expectations, interactions, and deep links before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review a system surface proposal
use_cases.description: Check whether a concept delivers timely value without exposing sensitive data or demanding unnecessary attention.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a system experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best Apple system experience for [user goal] on [platform]. Explain the content, primary action, and deep-link destination.

prompt_templates.title: Design widget variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Design widget variants for [app feature] on [platform]. Define content priority, supported sizes, layout changes, interactions, refresh timing, and privacy constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Live Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Live Activity for [event]. Cover start and end conditions, update cadence, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island presentations, actions, alerts, and stale-data handling.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a cross-surface system
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this proposal: [proposal]. Compare widgets, notifications, Live Activities, shortcuts, and watch complications. Identify conflicts, accessibility risks, privacy concerns, and a prioritized revision plan.

output_examples.input: Choose a system surface for tracking a food delivery from pickup through arrival.
output: Recommendation: Use a Live Activity because the event has a clear start, frequent updates, and a definite end.
Content: Show delivery stage, estimated arrival, courier status, and one essential action.
Presentation: Support Lock Screen plus compact, minimal, and expanded Dynamic Island states.
Deep link: Open the active order detail, not the app home screen.

output_examples.input: Plan widgets for a personal finance app without revealing private balances.
output: Offer small and medium widgets focused on budget progress and upcoming bill counts.
Replace exact balances with user-selected summaries or privacy-safe status labels.
Use direct links to the relevant budget or bill after authentication.
Test tinted, accented, dark, and accessibility appearances.

output_examples.input: Review notification actions for a medication reminder.
output: Keep notification text discreet and avoid exposing medication details by default.
Provide clear actions such as Mark Taken and Remind Later.
Require confirmation before destructive or irreversible changes.
Group repeated reminders and stop them after the user responds.

best_practices: Provide the platform, user goal, content sensitivity, and expected update frequency.
Design each size or presentation for its available space instead of scaling one layout.
Validate recommendations on real devices with accessibility settings and alternate rendering modes.
anti_patterns: Do not use a system surface as a smaller copy of the full application.
Do not expose sensitive information on Lock Screens, notifications, widgets, or watch faces.
Do not send frequent updates or alerts when the information has low user value.

faq.question: Does this skill generate SwiftUI code?
faq.answer: No. It produces design recommendations, content strategy, layout guidance, update expectations, and interaction behavior.

faq.question: Which Apple experiences are covered?
faq.answer: It covers widgets, Live Activities, notifications, complications, quick actions, Top Shelf, watch faces, App Clips, and App Shortcuts.

faq.question: Can it choose between a widget and a Live Activity?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares the user goal, event duration, update cadence, visibility, interaction needs, and platform constraints.

faq.question: Does it support every Apple platform?
faq.answer: The references include relevant guidance for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS, CarPlay, and StandBy where applicable.

faq.question: Does it replace current Apple documentation?
faq.answer: No. Confirm implementation details, dimensions, APIs, and recent platform changes against current Apple documentation.

faq.question: What information improves the recommendation?
faq.answer: Provide the platform, primary user task, data sensitivity, update frequency, supported sizes, desired actions, and deep-link destination.
